description: This is the main entry point for a React web application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, along with CSS styles and the App component. It renders the App component into a DOM element with id 'root' within a React.StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React element tree in a specified DOM container.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React element into the root DOM node.
